# Local token history fixtures

Shaped, not captured: made-up sessions in the on-disk shapes ccusage's MIT
adapters document for Pi, Grok, Gemini CLI and OpenClaw, read by
`src/jrbar/local_token_history.py`. No prompt text, no paths from a real Mac.
The OpenClaw per-agent SQLite store is built by the test itself.
`tests/test_local_token_history.py` holds the golden totals.
